title: Portal or wormhole theory for the ranch

tellings.quote: >> When Dr. Taylor and others speculate that there's a portal for portals or wormholes on Skinwalker Ranch,

plain: Some believe that Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, has a portal or wormhole on it, a passage through space and time. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, brings this up with Michels as a guess made by a scientist he calls Dr. Taylor and by others. If true, it would explain why so many strange things are reported there.
